key_insight: Random splits reward recipe memorisation, while provenance-grouped evaluation reveals stronger generalisation by composition-aware neural models on unseen institutions and future discoveries.
engineering_relevance: Evaluating models beyond familiar recipes can help engineers select tools better suited to proposing genuinely new perovskite solar-cell designs.
method: Map institutional provenance in the Perovskite Database.
Apply hierarchical grouped splits separating duplicate devices, publications and institutions.
Benchmark 13 models and analyse feature importance.
evidence_signal: Nearly two-thirds of curated devices share an exact recipe with another device, and model rankings shift from tree ensembles under random splits toward composition-aware neural architectures under harder evaluations.
watch_item: Reliable implementation depends on accurate recipe matching and provenance metadata; the abstract provides no numerical performance margins.
paper_title: Provenance-grouped protocol for evaluating machine learning in perovskite photovoltaics
